name: grunt
description: Grunt charts and tables: skills for charts and tables inside PowerPoint (powerpoint), in .pptx files built outside PowerPoint (pptx), in interactive HTML reports (html) and in Claude Slides decks (slides). Works through the Grunt connector your organization has connected.

interface.shortDescription: Grunt charts in HTML reports and PowerPoint decks
interface.longDescription: Create Grunt charts and tables through the Grunt connector your organization has connected, then place them on slides inside PowerPoint (powerpoint), in .pptx files built outside PowerPoint (pptx), in interactive, self-contained HTML reports (html) or in Claude Slides decks (slides). Sign in with your own Grunt account.
defaultPrompt: Create a Grunt bar chart of quarterly revenue by region and put it on slide 2 of deck.pptx.
Build an HTML report with a Grunt line chart of monthly customers and a KPI table.
